**About Team & About Role**
As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org.
  
  
You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains.
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems.
* Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions.
* Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought.
* Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic.
* Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly.
* Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed.
* Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET.
* Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.).
* Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature.
* Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status.

**Requirements**
**Must-have**

* Strong hands-on programming skills in Golang.
* Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory.
* Applied cryptography/PKI experience: X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS.
* Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work.
* Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.
* Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.
* Simple, effective written and verbal communication.

**Nice-to-have**

* Directory internals (schema, bind operations).
* HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection).
* Build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI).
* Secret-manager internals, Redis, Win32, policy engines.

title: Digital Customer Insights & Renewal Intelligence Specialist
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
Digital Customer Success provides structured, scalable Customer Success engagement for customers outside dedicated one-to-one coverage. The function combines customer intelligence, proactive risk identification, digital engagement, and cross-functional coordination to help customers realize value and enable account teams to take timely, informed action.
  
  
You will own the account-intelligence and renewal-risk workstream, converting multi-source customer data into repeatable health reviews, early-warning insights, portfolio reporting, and actionable Customer Success narratives. The role combines hands-on analysis with process ownership, data quality, stakeholder coordination, and automation readiness.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**Account health reviews:**
Build standardised reviews that combine renewal timing, product usage, entitlement, support activity, training, certification, version adoption and customer sentiment into clear strengths, risks and recommended actions.
  
  
**Early-warning and risk analysis:**
Maintain risk inputs, logic, thresholds and tiering; validate outputs and distinguish genuine customer risk from data gaps.
  
  
**Portfolio and segmentation:**
Maintain priority account cohorts using approved segmentation rules, renewal timing, risk triggers and stakeholder inputs.
  
  
**Renewal intelligence:**
Track renewal cohorts, surface concerns early and prepare account-level inputs for regional renewal reviews.
  
  
**Risk and leadership reporting:**
Produce concise account and portfolio reporting with evidence, data-quality caveats and recommended follow-up.
  
  
**CRM health narratives:**
Draft and maintain clear health, risk and next-step entries aligned to the review cadence.
  
  
**Data and source management:**
Extract, reconcile and quality-check information from CRM, BI, usage, support, training, version and survey sources.
  
  
**Cross-functional collaboration:**
Work with account teams, Customer Success Operations and technical data owners to validate context and recommendations.
  
  
**Documentation and controls:**
Maintain source links, definitions, standard operating procedures, quality checks, templates and cadence calendars.
  
  
**Automation and enablement:**
Help translate review and risk-reporting processes into scalable workflows while preserving quality and traceability.
  
  
What You'll Need
  
  
**Experience:**
3–5 years in Customer Success operations, customer-health or renewal analytics, business analytics, data analytics or comparable work.
  
  
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Analytics, Business, Information Systems or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  
  
**Data capability:**
Advanced Excel skills and demonstrated experience handling and reconciling multiple data sources.
  
  
**Reporting tools:**
Hands-on experience with a business intelligence tool such as Power BI and experience working with CRM data.
  
  
**Business judgement:**
Working understanding of customer health, adoption, churn or attrition risk, renewals and Customer Success operating models.
  
  
**Communication:**
Ability to convert complex evidence into concise, defensible narratives and practical recommendations for business stakeholders.
  
  
**Operating discipline:**
High attention to detail, source traceability, documentation quality and recurring delivery commitments.
  
  
**Preferred / Nice To Have**
**Customer Success platforms:**
Experience with Gainsight or a comparable platform.
  
  
**Data and automation:**
Exposure to Snowflake or other data-warehouse extracts, Power Query, SQL, scripting or workflow automation.
  
  
**Relevant models:**
Experience developing health scores, early-warning models, renewal dashboards or executive account reviews.
  
  
**Industry context:**
Experience in B2B enterprise software or industrial software.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
**Reliable delivery:**
Account reviews, risk refreshes, reports and CRM narratives are accurate and completed against an agreed operating calendar.
  
  
**Actionable insight:**
Account teams can understand the evidence, validate the context and act on the recommendations.
  
  
**Data integrity:**
Material data gaps are visible and tracked rather than being misclassified as customer risk.
  
  
**Scalability:**
Processes and controls are documented and progressively standardised or automated without reducing quality.
  
  
How This Role Works
  
  
This role supports customers and internal stakeholders across multiple regions and requires effective collaboration in a globally distributed environment. The role enables account teams with structured insights or scaled engagement and does not replace commercial account ownership.

**Required qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in BI or data engineering.

* Practical experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse/Warehouse, Pipelines, Dataflows, Notebooks), or strong Azure data experience (Synapse, Data Factory, Databricks) and the will to move to Fabric quickly.

* Experience with Git, deployment pipelines and CI/CD for Fabric or Power BI.
* Interest in AI use cases on top of data, for example Copilot or Fabric data agents.

**About Onit**
We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.
  
  
We’re a team of innovators using
**AI at the core**
to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.
  
  
If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
****Position Summary****
The Data Scientist owns the statistical methodology behind a new customer-facing benchmarking capability in Onit's AI-driven legal operations platform. Drawing on data from multiple source systems across enterprise legal management, matter management, and spend management, this role determines which organizations are genuinely comparable, decides where the line sits between a defensible comparison and one that is not, and ensures the product communicates confidence honestly to end users. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and the Data Architect on a Databricks-based platform, the Data Scientist sets the evidential standards, data quality targets, and governance for pooled, anonymised cross-customer analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Benchmarking Methodology: Own the statistical methodology behind customer-facing benchmarking, end to end.
* Comparability Modelling: Build and validate a model that determines which organizations are genuinely comparable, using features such as service mix, pricing, scale, and geography.
* Defensibility Thresholds: Decide where the line sits between a comparison Onit can defend and one it cannot, and design the product's behaviour on both sides of it.
* Data Quality Programme: Profile data quality across multiple source systems and lead a measurable improvement programme against a defined target, partnering with Data Engineering on remediation.
* Entity Resolution: Define the approach for resolving duplicate and conflicting records across systems that were never designed to reconcile with one another.
* External Data Assessment: Assess whether missing attributes can be responsibly supplemented from external sources, and set the evidential bar for doing so.
* Governance & Privacy: Work with Product on methodology and governance for pooled, anonymised cross-customer analytics, including aggregation thresholds.
* Communicating Uncertainty: Explain uncertainty clearly to non-statisticians and help the product communicate confidence honestly to end users.

**Required Skills**

* 7+ years in applied data science, analytics engineering, or a closely related quantitative role, including ownership of methodology for externally facing analytics.
* Strong applied statistics: sampling, variance, confidence intervals, and sound judgement about small samples (e.g., able to explain why a three-item average may or may not be publishable).
* Practical, production experience with entity resolution, record linkage, deduplication, or master data management.
* Strong SQL, and Python or Ruby for analysis and modelling; hands-on experience working in Databricks (notebooks, Spark/PySpark, Delta tables) or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Experience diagnosing and remediating data quality problems at scale, including reasoning about why data is missing before deciding what to do about it.
* Rigorous validation habits: defines baselines and success metrics before building, and reports honestly against them.
* Ability to communicate uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders without overstating confidence or being unhelpfully vague.
* Working proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate analysis, code, and documentation, with the statistical judgment to critically validate AI-generated output.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building benchmarks, rate comparisons, scoring models, or indices intended for external consumption.
* Experience with anonymisation, aggregation thresholds, or privacy-preserving analytics.
* Experience working with a cloud data warehouse or lakehouse (Databricks preferred).
* Experience in a regulated or commercially sensitive domain, ideally legal.

At BlueConic, we’re reinventing how businesses grow by transforming customer data into real-time intelligence and action.
  
  
As a group, we are driven by “building the dream” - the collective passion, ethic, vision, and set of values channeled by a group to achieve a common goal of being extraordinary. Our goal is for BlueConic to be a fun, productive, welcoming, and safe space where BlueCrew members of all races and ethnicities, gender identities, gender expressions, sexual orientations, physical abilities, neurodivergences, physical appearances, socioeconomic backgrounds, life experiences, nationalities, ages, religions, and beliefs are empowered to be able to make an outsized impact every day – for customers, for partners, for employees.
  
  
Join us in shaping the future of customer engagement—where advanced machine learning, causal decisioning, and real-time experimentation come together to power next-best actions at scale.
  
  
**Data Scientist**
We’re looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our Product & Technology team. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of core product development and customer-facing data science, helping build and apply advanced decisioning capabilities that power real-time personalization, experimentation, and growth optimization.
  
  
You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and customer teams to design, implement, and operationalize predictive and decisioning models—both as part of BlueConic’s product roadmap and in direct partnership with customers solving high-impact growth challenges.
  
  
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys moving from theory to production, and from models to real-world outcomes.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* Design, build, and productionize predictive and decisioning models that power BlueConic’s product capabilities, including next-best-action and real-time personalization
* Apply and advance techniques in causal inference, reinforcement learning (specifically: contextual multi-armed bandits) to optimize customer interactions and measure incremental impact
* Partner with product and engineering teams to embed models into scalable, real-time systems
* Work directly with customers on advanced use cases, developing and validating models tailored to their business objectives and data environments
* Translate business goals into modeling strategies, and communicate results clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Contribute to experimentation frameworks, uplift modeling, and closed-loop optimization approaches
* Help shape best practices for data science within the product organization, including model evaluation, testing, and deployment standards

**We are looking for someone with following skills**
**Required:**

* 5+ years of professional experience as a Data Scientist, Applied Scientist, or similar role
* Strong hands-on experience with causal inference techniques (e.g. uplift modeling, counterfactual analysis, A/B and quasi-experimental methods)
* Practical experience with reinforcement learning and contextual multi-armed bandits in real-world systems
* Solid foundation in machine learning, including experience with libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, or equivalent
* Advanced Python skills, including software engineering best practices (unit testing, modular code, packaging, version control)
* Experience taking models from experimentation to production environments

**Preferred:**

* Experience with turning models into Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) format
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms or modern data stacks (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, feature stores)
* Experience working on B2C, personalization, marketing, or customer analytics use cases
* Experience with recommendation algorithms
* Comfort collaborating directly with customers or external stakeholders on advanced analytical projects

**You will be a great fit if you**

* Enjoy working on problems where measurement, causality, and decision-making really matter
* Are equally comfortable thinking about algorithms, product impact, and customer outcomes
* Care about building robust, maintainable data science systems—not just notebooks
